title: Preserve canonical loopback origin during Staging One-Click bootstrap

phases.objective: Prevent the tunnel-disabled bootstrap interval from rewriting the canonical shared loopback origin to the obsolete Docker service hostname.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One-Click preserves http://127.0.0.1:8080 before Bootstrap-Staging-One-Click invokes Start-AutoPilot, so the exact-origin guard can proceed while tunnel startup remains disabled until the selected mode is restored.
steps: Initialize the canonical Staging environment for the selected tunnel mode.
Disable tunnel startup for the bootstrap interval without changing the canonical loopback origin.
Run the exact-commit bootstrap and restore the selected tunnel mode.
Reject any regression that writes http://app:8080 into CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ORIGIN_APP.
assertions: The bootstrap interval writes CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ORIGIN_APP exactly as http://127.0.0.1:8080.
Invoke-Staging-One-Click-Core.ps1 contains no setter that writes the obsolete http://app:8080 origin.
No Production deployment, database mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, or Production activation is authorized.

phases.objective: Preserve shared source compatibility without authorizing Production execution.
blockers: Production remains outside this repair and requires its separate governed promotion lifecycle.
